verdict.rationale: BVNK documents an API-based fiat-to-crypto onramp. You create virtual accounts in USD, EUR or GBP for your customers, then use `POST /payment/v1/rules` to link a fiat virtual account to a blockchain address so incoming bank transfers are automatically on-ramped. Embedded Wallets let partners offer this under their own branding. There is no evidence of card-funded stablecoin purchases or an embeddable onramp widget; the virtual cards mentioned are for spending stablecoin balances, not buying them. Missing for 10: card-based purchase of stablecoins, a drop-in onramp widget/UI, end-user buy-flow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
